author: ALM
body:
Hello everyone!

I am pleased to announce that I have pushed out a major and long needed update to the Avicus XML documentation website. As many of you have seen, the docs were previously missing a lot of new features and lacking a lot of examples. This will no longer be an issue.

With this update, the docs are now generated by Atlas itself. The issue previously was that updating Atlas and the docs was a long process and it was easier to just update Atlas and plan to update the docs later. Now both are written in the same place to make it convenient to provide accurate and up-to-date documentation.

The new docs are also full of examples. Now, Atlas will yell and scream if every feature does not have an example. The examples are also parsed by Atlas to check for accuracy so there will no longer be any broken examples. 

The specification on the sidebar is also now always accurate to what the newest specification supported by Atlas. The version history is also now automatically generated so it contains all of the changes with each version so that you are aware of any breaking changes or new features.

I would like to give a big thanks to {tag=3cce00809faa48f982cf64410305822a} for writing most of the examples and helping me proofread the examples and documentation attributes. Everyone give him props for all of his hard work!

As always, the docs are located at http://docs.avicus.net/.

Thanks, and happy XMLing
Austin
